svg.title: Extra attacks caught with kernel evidence + notes
svg.desc: Line chart with a shaded band of the difference in attacks caught between kernel evidence plus notes and commands only, for audit budgets from 0 to 25%. The line starts about 20 attacks above zero below 1%, then hovers a few attacks below zero; the 95% band includes zero throughout
svg.text: Extra attacks caught with kernel evidence + notes
Difference from commands only, out of 233 successful attacks, with a 95% band from 1,000 resamples.
Audit budget: share of honest runs a human reviews
